title: Great earthquake destroys Lisbon
summary: A massive earthquake, followed by a tsunami and fires, destroyed most of Lisbon on All Saints' Day. Tens of thousands of people died.
reason: A sudden rupture along the plate boundary in the Atlantic southwest of Portugal released enormous energy close to the densely built capital.
significance: It shook European faith in divine providence, inspired Enlightenment debate and led to early modern seismology and urban planning.
